note: Library cleanup write-before checkpoint. Compare multiple manual control actions.

strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not remove songs yet. First list library songs, liked songs, and downloaded songs. Compute remove_set = library - liked - downloaded. Print counts, then remove only remove_set. Do not submit a natural-language answer.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before any deletion, verify the exact remove set: songs/albums that are in the library but neither liked nor downloaded. Print the candidate IDs. Only delete verified candidates; keep liked/downloaded items untouched.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Abandon the current removal plan. Re-plan the cleanup in order: login Spotify -> enumerate library/liked/downloaded -> compute set difference -> remove only the difference -> complete_task() with answer=None.

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Before deleting, call show_api_doc for the Spotify remove/show liked/downloaded APIs you will use. Confirm parameter names and access_token requirements, then continue the cleanup with the verified APIs.
